description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” presents a side-by-side comparison of two models — LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue) and an unnamed baseline (orange) — across nine different evaluation datasets and metrics, plotted along the horizontal axis labeled “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, ranges from 0 to 80 with tick marks every 10 units. For each dataset, two adjacent bars show the performance of each model. LLaMA-3-8B-it achieves its highest score on GSM-8K at approximately 79%, closely matched by the baseline at around 80%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores about 66%, while the baseline scores slightly lower at ~65%. HumanEval shows LLaMA-3-8B-it at ~62% and the baseline at ~64%. TruthfulQA reveals a notable gap, with LLaMA-3-8B-it at ~44% and the baseline at ~60%. On ARC, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~59% versus the baseline’s ~64%. MBPP shows both models near parity at ~61%. LC AlpacaEval2 shows LLaMA-3-8B-it at ~23% and the baseline at ~32%. MT-Bench (×5) shows LLaMA-3-8B-it at ~41% and the baseline at ~43%. Chat-Arena-Hard shows LLaMA-3-8B-it at ~21% and the baseline at ~29%. Overall, the baseline model outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it on five of the nine benchmarks, particularly on TruthfulQA, LC AlpacaEval2, and Chat-Arena-Hard, while LLaMA-3-8B-it leads on GSM-8K, MMLU, and HumanEval. The chart visually emphasizes performance differences through color-coded bars and consistent spacing, with no sorting applied to the x-axis categories.
